title: ZO Skin Centre
summary: Website redesign for a skincare clinic group, built to win more online bookings.
goal: More online bookings, one clear path across several clinic locations, and the key services up front.

targetUsers.label: Patients (25–65)
targetUsers.description: Want treatments, doctors they can trust, and an easy way to book.

targetUsers.label: Dermatologists
targetUsers.description: Need their credentials and expertise seen.

discoveryNote: Worked directly with the clinic manager on what was getting in the way.
insights: Booking online was harder than it should be.
A page per location confused people and pushed bounce rate up.
Visitors wanted treatments, results and reviews in one place.
competitorAnalysis: Competitors led with strong imagery and a short booking flow — the bar to clear.

personas.name: Rahman
personas.wants: Plain details on treatments and doctors.
personas.motivations: A design that reads as trustworthy.

userFlows.name: Book a Consultation
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Select service → Choose doctor → Fill booking form

userFlows.name: Explore Treatments
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Treatments page → Detailed service info → View gallery

userFlows.name: View Results
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Gallery / Before & After → Filter by treatment

userFlows.name: Read Reviews
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Testimonials section → Filter by treatment or doctor

wireframes: Low-fidelity sketches first, to settle the layout.
Booking CTA up front; every location on the homepage.
Mid- then high-fidelity prototypes before final UI.
visualDirection: White space, modern type and light medical cues to build trust.
On the parent brand's theme, with its own distinguishing elements.

title: Ibadat
summary: A prayer and lifestyle app for Muslims: prayer times, authentic duas, smart notifications.
goal: A modern Islamic app for daily prayer, authentic duas, and smart features that make the day easier.

targetUsers.label: Muslims (15–65)
targetUsers.description: Accurate prayer times, duas to hand, no distractions while praying.

targetUsers.label: Mosque-goers
targetUsers.description: The phone goes silent on its own when they arrive.

discoveryNote: Worked with the client to sharpen the vision and what users expected.
insights: People wanted to pray without touching their phone.
Prayer-time accuracy and localisation were non-negotiable.
Duas had to be clearly authentic, with Quran and Hadith references.
A personal feed tied to Islamic dates could keep people coming back.
competitorAnalysis: Existing apps gave prayer times, little else, and no personalisation.
Almost none had mosque-based silent mode or custom dua collections.

personas.name: Ayesha
personas.wants: Accurate alerts, referenced duas, a distraction-free mosque.
personas.preferences: Clean, modern, easy to move around.
personas.motivations: Staying consistent with prayer around student life.

personas.name: Karim
personas.wants: Silent mode in the mosque and a personal dua collection.
personas.motivations: Fitting faith into a full work schedule.

userFlows.name: Prayer Times & Alerts
userFlows.steps: Launch app → Enable location → Prayer times displayed → Notifications set

userFlows.name: Mosque Silent Mode
userFlows.steps: User enters mosque → App detects location → Phone switches to silent automatically

userFlows.name: Browse Duas
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Dua collection → Select dua → View reference and translation → Save to personal list

userFlows.name: Explore Feed
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Feed section → Weekly / monthly / yearly Islamic insights → Engage with content

wireframes: Low-fidelity wireframes for prayer times, duas and the feed.
High-fidelity designs with a consistent Islamic visual style.
visualDirection: Calm colour, clean type, clear icons.
Accessible and easy to navigate across a wide age range.

keyScreens.name: Prayer Times Screen
keyScreens.description: Location-based times with alerts.

keyScreens.name: Dua Collection
keyScreens.description: Indexed library with references, translations and edits.

keyScreens.description: Weekly, monthly and yearly insights tied to Islamic events.

keyScreens.name: Silent Mode Feature
keyScreens.description: Detects mosque entry; one toggle.

keyScreens.description: Calculation methods, alerts, personalisation.

expectedOutcomes.label: Distraction-free prayers
expectedOutcomes.description: Silent mode handles the phone in the mosque.

expectedOutcomes.label: Personalization
expectedOutcomes.description: Translations and settings to suit each user.

expectedOutcomes.label: Engagement
expectedOutcomes.description: A feed that gives a reason to return.

expectedOutcomes.label: Scalability
expectedOutcomes.description: Room for community and event features later.

title: Alokito Teacher
summary: A redesign of Alokito Teacher's site, with a new job portal linking teachers to work.
goal: A modern, consistent brand refresh, plus pricing plans and a job portal for teachers.

targetUsers.label: Institutions and schools
targetUsers.description: Trained teachers to hire, through the portal.

discoveryNote: Worked directly with the client on feedback and requirements.
insights: The old site felt dated and off-brand for a fun, modern identity.
Teachers wanted a simple way to browse and buy courses.
The job portal had to make search-and-apply easy.
High-value course bundles needed a prominent home.
competitorAnalysis: Education platforms with strong branding and clear navigation set the bar.
The best job portals keep search and filtering frictionless.

personas.name: Arif
personas.wants: A reliable place to find trained teachers.

userFlows.name: Explore Pricing Packages

userFlows.name: Job Search & Apply
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Job portal → Search and filter jobs → Apply

userFlows.name: Institution Hiring Flow

wireframes: Low-fidelity wireframes for home, courses, pricing and the portal.
Consistent layouts that carry the fun, educational brand.
High-fidelity prototypes shaped by client and stakeholder feedback.
visualDirection: Clean type, bright accents, approachable UI.

title: TaxRise
summary: A redesign of TaxRise Inc's website to modernise the brand, tighten consistency and lift conversions.
goal: A modern, consistent site that converts better and holds its own in the market.

targetUsers.label: Clients (25–60)
targetUsers.description: Trustworthy tax help, clear information, an easy first step.

targetUsers.label: Internal teams (SEO and marketing)
targetUsers.description: A site on brand, built to convert, easy to extend for campaigns.

discoveryNote: Worked closely with stakeholders and the SEO and marketing teams.
insights: Inconsistency between pages was costing trust.
Conversion flows leaked people along the way.
SEO and marketing needed a structure they could build campaigns on.
competitorAnalysis: Competitors used modern, professional layouts with strong trust signals and clear CTAs.
The gap: a stronger visual identity and a smoother way in.

personas.name: John
personas.wants: Services explained plainly and a fast way to reach an expert.

personas.name: Linda
personas.wants: Clear steps to resolve a tax problem.

userFlows.name: Request Consultation
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Services → Select service → Contact form

userFlows.name: Learn About Services

userFlows.name: Build Trust
userFlows.steps: Homepage → Reviews / Testimonials → Case Studies → Contact

userFlows.name: Resources Access

wireframes: Low-fidelity wireframes to set structure and layout.
CTAs and trust elements — reviews, credentials — placed first.
visualDirection: A full style guide: type, colour, components, layouts.
Trust made visible: testimonials, success metrics, case highlights.
